findings: The ordinary unchanged-main control passes. A held POST reproduces the same missing Saved / recovered assertion on unchanged application code.
The receipt lookup returns 404 before the intercepted POST is forwarded and accepted with 200. The UI retains the unknown original instead of inventing success.
The correction verifies the real POST response is successful and waits for the explicit Recover original result control to become enabled after the dropped response settles, before reload.
The initial local unmodified attempt started before the baseline listener was ready and failed navigation; it is retained separately and is not used as the causal reproduction.
No timeout, retry policy, assertion deadline, application behaviour or performance target changes. The 1500 ms injection is diagnostic only and is absent from the committed test.
